summary: Apply `norm_jetSeries_le` with L = jet along Q′ and r = 1; for a theta product the jet is integral by `CMLattice.jet_theta_prod_integral`.

steps.claim: The proof is by the single equation of the definition, for the premise Q′ = map Q (`rfl`).
steps.lean:
| rfl => norm_jetSeries_le hf _ _ (r := 1) fun _ ⟨_, _, _, _, m, _, _, hw, _, hk, _, hy⟩ ↦ by
    have := hk.2.norm_natCast_eq_one ℂ_[p]
    simpa [map_jet, *] using! P.cmCurve.jet_theta_prod_integral (by simpa [apply_ite, ite_apply,
      field, *, ne] using (fun _ _ ↦ norm_periodFactor_mul_conj_le_one (hw.1 _))) ⟨m * δ,
      rfl⟩ (by clear * - h0 this; aesop) hy Q

steps.claim: With Q′ = image of Q: apply `norm_jetSeries_le` with c = δ̄·d, L = the jet along Q′ and r = 1. For a theta product Θ (frame w tight of length m, |ιₚ(b)| = |ιₚ(δ̄ d s₁)|, n·δ·y_i ∈ Λ with n prime to p), ιₚ(jet_{Q′}Θ) is the jet of the product of the ιₚ-Taylor series of U_{y_i}θ substituted at linear forms whose coefficients c_{i,x} satisfy |ιₚ(δ̄)⁻¹c_{i,x}/d| ≤ 1 (`norm_periodFactor_mul_conj_le_one`, n a p-adic unit); `CMLattice.jet_theta_prod_integral` (with m·δ) gives |·| ≤ 1.
steps.lean:
| rfl => norm_jetSeries_le hf _ _ (r := 1) fun _ ⟨_, _, _, _, m, _, _, hw, _, hk, _, hy⟩ ↦ by
    have := hk.2.norm_natCast_eq_one ℂ_[p]
    simpa [map_jet, *] using! P.cmCurve.jet_theta_prod_integral (by simpa [apply_ite, ite_apply,
      field, *, ne] using (fun _ _ ↦ norm_periodFactor_mul_conj_le_one (hw.1 _))) ⟨m * δ,
      rfl⟩ (by clear * - h0 this; aesop) hy Q
